name: Multiple interacting bugs across files
description: Tax multiplier in tax.py computes whole integer percentage, distorting invoice calculation in invoice.py.
expected_behavior: calculate_invoice_total properly applies percentage as decimal fraction (10% -> 1.10).
golden_patch:
--- a/tax.py
+++ b/tax.py
@@ -1,3 +1,3 @@
 def compute_tax_multiplier(rate_percent: float) -> float:
-    return 1.0 + rate_percent
+    return 1.0 + (rate_percent / 100.0)
